steps:
Use case: ads-marketing + precise-object-edit.
Create ONE finished Instagram carousel cover for PixelMurmur. Portrait 4:5, 1080 by 1350 intended output. This is slide 1 of a three-slide design-choice series, not a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the exact approved PM-001 product identity reference: cream rounded-square toaster-shaped charging dock, golden toast-shaped battery inserted, gold rim, dark LCD with pixel smile, right-hand golden lever and side USB-C port. Preserve the product silhouette, toast texture, proportions, materials, camera angle and lighting closely.
Show TWO alternatives at IDENTICAL size and IDENTICAL three-quarter front-right angle, side by side on a continuous warm cream studio background. Left A is exactly the original with the dark smiling screen. Right B changes ONLY the dark LCD screen plane into a blank cream panel matching the shell: keep the gold rim, toaster shell, bread, lever, side USB-C port, all geometry and camera identical. No smile or screen on B; do not change the whole product.
Art direction: product-first, premium tactile product-design editorial, crisp and warm. Products fill most of usable canvas width, clean realistic soft shadows. Compact top typography, NO giant empty top margin. Same product baseline; neither option gets a glow, halo, extra props or visual preference. No phone, hands, arrows, cables, packaging, sales badges or UI controls.
Typography: bold clean Korean sans serif, dark espresso #342315, small English support, impeccably legible and exact. 6% safe margin on all sides. Content layout:
Top small brand 'pixelmurmur.' left, 'PM-001 · 01 / 03' right.
Large headline on at most two lines: '얼굴, 있어야 할까?'
Smaller English directly below: 'Does it need a face?'
Small descriptor: '토스트 보조배터리 + 충전 도크'
Under product A: 'A · 화면 있음' and smaller 'With a screen'
Under product B: 'B · 화면 없음' and smaller 'Without a screen'
Near bottom strong question: '내 책상에는 A, 아니면 B?'
Small supporting English: 'Which belongs on your desk?'
Bottom compact two-line disclosure, readable and within safe margin: 'AI 콘셉트 렌더 · 아직 제작되지 않음' and 'AI CONCEPT RENDER · NOT YET PRODUCED'
Only render these exact text strings. Do not invent logos, claims, additional text or a manufactured-product impression. Make a polished final marketing image, not an app screenshot.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the middle product-comparison region of this finished PixelMurmur slide. Preserve the exact 1122 x 1402 canvas, all text content, every font size, text position, background, brand, footer, color and product identity.
The pair of toaster charging docks are too close to the left and right edge for a narrower profile-thumbnail crop. Scale BOTH products uniformly to 88% of their current size and move them inward, keeping their left/right order and equal scale. Keep each centered over its current A or B label. Keep them fully in the central image band, centered vertically between the descriptor and the labels, with proportionate realistic shadows. Target at least 80 px clearance between every product extremity (including the right-hand gold lever) and both outer canvas edges. Do not resize just one option. Maintain matching 3/4 front-right perspective. Do not change the A face display, B cream front panel, gold rims, toast shapes or USB-C ports.
This is a single targeted crop-safety correction. Do not reword text, do not change the layout, do not add anything, and do not make the headline bigger. Return one final cover.

Use case: ads-marketing, carousel continuation.
Create ONE finished slide 2 of the exact PixelMurmur Instagram carousel represented by reference image 1. Keep the SAME portrait aspect ratio, exact canvas dimensions, cream background, espresso type, brand position, top/foot safety margins and typography family as reference image 1. Reference image 2 is the exact approved product identity.
This slide presents alternative A alone. One large centered product, occupying the main middle region: the original cream toaster charging dock with gold trim, dark LCD and pixel smile, inserted toast power bank, right gold lever and USB-C port. Preserve the product exactly, the same 3/4 front-right angle, bread proportions and texture, and warm soft studio lighting. No new props or extra objects. Show the entire product without cropping. This is an unproduced concept, no manufacturing/performance/sales claims.
Layout must match reference 1's compact header and footer, no giant top blank band. A single hero can be larger than either individual product in the comparison, but keep the top edge of the toast and bottom edge of dock within the same central image band. Text exact:
top left 'pixelmurmur.'; top right 'PM-001 · 02 / 03'
headline '표정 있는 도크.'
English headline 'A little character.'
small line beneath 'A · 화면 있는 안 / With a screen'
Below the product, main supporting line '충전 상태도, 작은 표정도.'
English line 'Charging status, with a little character.'
Bottom disclosure 'AI 콘셉트 렌더 · 아직 제작되지 않음'
second footer line 'AI CONCEPT RENDER · NOT YET PRODUCED'
Keep all text comfortably inside the frame; clean Korean sans serif, no extra words. Do not add an A/B comparison or second product on this slide. Precisely reuse the reference's warm cream, gold and espresso system.

Use case: precise-object-edit + text-localization.
Make slide 3 of the same PixelMurmur carousel by editing reference image 1 (slide 2). Preserve EXACTLY its canvas dimensions and aspect ratio, all layout coordinates, type family, font sizes, brand position, cream background, light, shadows, margins and product placement/scale. Reference image 2 shows both alternatives, use the right-hand B only as a reference for the new blank cream front panel.
Only image change: replace the original dark LCD face plane with a plain cream panel matching the shell, as in reference image 2's B. Remove all dark glass and pixel smile. Preserve the gold front rim, shell, toast battery shape/texture/orientation, top slot, lever, USB-C port, feet, camera and product dimensions EXACTLY unchanged. Do not remove the gold rim. One product only. No added props.
Only text changes:
'PM-001 · 02 / 03' -> 'PM-001 · 03 / 03'
'표정 있는 도크.' -> '화면 없는 도크.'
'A little character.' -> 'A quieter presence.'
'A · 화면 있는 안' -> 'B · 화면 없는 안'
'With a screen' -> 'Without a screen'
'충전 상태도, 작은 표정도.' -> '화면을 덜어낸 단정한 앞면.'
'Charging status, with a little character.' -> 'A simpler front, without a display.'
Preserve the brand 'pixelmurmur.' and the complete two footer lines exactly: 'AI 콘셉트 렌더 · 아직 제작되지 않음' / 'AI CONCEPT RENDER · NOT YET PRODUCED'.
Do not change any other visual detail. Clean legible Korean typography. This is a concept variant, not a real manufactured or tested object. Return one completed slide, matching the original slide precisely.
